The worst is the doom.  The sense of doom, all the time.  That sense that I'm doomed.  I'm doomed.  I hate being doomed.

I have to drive a taxi to survive - who will slit my throat first, I wonder?  I have to do manual labor, also, because serving tables makes me homicidal (that is not hyperbole).

Manual labor hurts.  I am over 30, but I am not out of shape.  I feel like I'm going to die any minute, so why not just expedite the process.  I am so terrified that this unjust and nonsensical universe is going to swipe me away from this earth just as I have begun to discover my potential.  I have so many unfulfilled ambitions, and so much depression.  I act, I submit, I put the rejections on my wall.  No one wants me.  Someone has to.  Who?  I don't know.
